text: The Fundacio FC Barcelona (Barca Foundation) is FC Barcelona's own charitable foundation, created in 1994. Its governing body is the Patronat (board of patrons) and its income comes mainly from the Club, the players and external financiers, with FC Barcelona contributing up to 0.7% of its income budget. It is a club-affiliated charity, not a state or state-fund entity.

source.name: Barca Foundation, Economic transparency
source.quote: The Foundation receive income from two main sources: the Club, players and external financiers
